title: Normalized natural isomorphism from the published tensor to a supplied tensor model
statement: Let $C$ be a category with objects in universe $u+1$ and morphisms in universe $u$, essentially small in universe $u+1$. Let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology on $C$ and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings in universe $u+1$. Use the module-sheaf category and its standard unbounded derived category $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $a$ be a TensorModel $R$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction], with bifunctor $T$ and natural representative comparison $r$ on pairs of flat-term K-flat cochain complexes. Write $T_0$ for the published derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent], and $c_{P,Q}:Q\operatorname{Tot}(P,Q)\cong T_0(QP,QQ)$ for representativeIso [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated]. There exists a natural isomorphism $e:T_0\cong T$ such that, for every pair of resolving complexes $P,Q$, $c_{P,Q}$ followed by $e_{QP,QQ}$ is exactly $r_{P,Q}$. No shift, boundedness, pullback, or nonzero-coefficient hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the normalized-isomorphism clause of cochain tensor model rigidity to the supplied bifunctor and its representative comparison. This gives e and equality of natural transformations on the product of the resolving cochain category. The supplied TensorModel and the rigidity theorem use definitionally identical coefficient universes, tensor functors, K-flatness and termwise flatness predicates.

The canonical cochain representative arrow is representativeIso. Unfold their displayed definitions: the quotient-to-derived isomorphism has identity components; the initial identity and the published tensor applied to the product identity cancel by functoriality. Both remaining arrows are the same homotopy tensor comparison followed by the same resolving comparison. Evaluate the equality from step 1 at P,Q and substitute this equality of representative arrows.

theorem ringedProjectionTensorModelIso (a : TensorModel R) :
    ∃ e : SheafOfModules.siteDerivedTensorIndependentCoefficients J R ≅ a.functor,
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (Mod R) ℤ) (hp : resolving R P) (hq : resolving R Q),
        (SheafOfModules.KFlatFixedTensor.representativeIso R P Q hp.1 hq.1 hp.2 hq.2).hom ≫
          e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) =
            a.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hp⟩, ⟨Q, hq⟩)
